notes: v569 — the 📋 report card can no longer hang on ‘Grading every signal…’. There was no time limit on the grading request: if the server never answered, the card waited forever with nothing to show and no way to tell you it had died. Now the quick cache check gives up after 20 seconds and a full grade after 90, and either failure shows the card's plain ‘couldn't reach the server’ message with a retry instead of an endless spinner. If you DO see that message, the grading server is genuinely unreachable — wait a minute and try again rather than reloading repeatedly. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
